website_summary.name: Campus Connect Forum
website_summary.description: The website displays an anonymous discussion platform with a sleek design, using honeydew as a background color and dark olive green for components, optimized for student engagement.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a clean, structured layout with a navigation header at the top labeled "Campus Connect." Below this is a main post section where discussion topics are listed. Each post has a title, user handle, time since posting, a brief description, and interaction icons for replies. The left sidebar includes categorized options for "Academics," "Campus Life," and "Events," as well as "Popular Tags" which help users find relevant discussions quickly with clickable buttons. The search bar is prominently positioned above the post list for easy navigation. The color scheme is consistent with honeydew (light background) and dark olive green used for buttons and interactive elements, giving the site a professional yet approachable appearance.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to create new posts, search through existing posts via a search bar, and anonymously browse through topics categorized under "Academics," "Campus Life," and "Events." Popular tags help users follow specific interests such as #Academics, #Events, etc. Students can interact with posts by clicking on a downward arrow, indicating replies or other forms of engagement. It supports notifications for updated posts and discussions. The platform is designed to protect user privacy by anonymizing users with handles like "user123."
